'''The Jungle Cantina''' was one of the finest [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. It was located in [[Isttu Village]]. The establishment was built around a central bar and had a number of tables. Three [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] worked at the bar, while six [[Waiter/Legends|waitresses]] were on hand to serve the tables. A secluded alcove was home to a four-piece band that played [[Music/Legends|music]] ranging from [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] classics to chart-topping popular tunes. Nearly everyone who visited the ''Bazaar'' went to The Jungle Cantina and it was the hub of news and rumors for the ship.<ref name="GA" />
